preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and int(line.split()[0]) == n)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after t is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2*10^5) representing the number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n-1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines())-1, n+1)]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges, each represented by a line with two integers u and v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n, u ≠ v), indicating an undirected edge between vertices u and v.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n and int(u) != int(v) for u, v in [line.split() for line in edges]) for n, edges in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n-1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines())-1, n+1)]))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(is_tree(edges, n) for n, edges in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n-1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines())-1, n+1)]))
preconditions.description: The given edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree) for each test case, with vertex 1 as the root.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == t for t, output_lines in zip([int(stdin.split()[0])], [stdin.splitlines()[i+1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines())-1, n+1) if i > 0]))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one integer per test case, in the same order as the input.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output) <= n for output, n in zip(output_lines, [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a valid number of leaves (1 ≤ output ≤ n) for the corresponding tree.

postconditions.expression: all(min_leaves_possible(edges, n) == int(output) for output, n, edges in zip(output_lines, [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n-1] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines())-1, n+1)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimal number of leaves achievable by performing any number of valid operations (re-hanging buds with their children to other vertices).
